summary: Wrote the standalone homily (about 1,300 words, 10.0-10.8 minutes at 120-130 wpm by arithmetic) for an adult parish assembly on the second interpretation, the leaven hidden in three measures: Ambrose on leaven as teaching, Augustine's leaven of love and Bede's commandment of the whole heart, soul and strength, Chrysostom on 'hid', Bede on 'until' and on the mustard seed, the Collect's thought, word and deed, the Thessalonians' labour of charity with Chrysostom on Jason, the cry from the depths, Bede's meal ground into one bread, one response from the Communion's promise, and the Postcommunion with Bede's 'begun here, perfected there'. Declared [document.homily] in publication.toml, refreshed homily.tex, wrote the terminal note and References, added the contribution line and the production-review entry; the author proof (4 pages, no overfull or underfull box) and the content, component, preflight and provenance checks pass. Paths to commit: sections/homily/10-homily.tex, sections/homily/90-note.tex, publication.toml, homily.tex, generation-metadata.tex, research/production-review.md (all under the DOCUMENT_ROOT). No upstream defect is new; the standing items for the study, research, shared-format and tool owners stand.
